Definition
[Frame representation of a metric]

Source: petersen:page-0034 ↗ def:pet-ch1-riemannian-manifold

A frame on $U\subset M$ is a family of pointwise linearly independent vector fields $X_1,\ldots ,X_n$. Its dual coframe $\sigma ^1,\ldots ,\sigma ^n$ satisfies $\sigma ^i(X_j)=\delta ^i_j$, and \[ g=g_{ij}\sigma ^i\sigma ^j, \qquad g_{ij}=g(X_i,X_j). \]
